content: Hey there! I keep rereading your last message, it always makes me smile. How are you holding up after your long week?
Aw, that's sweet of you. Honestly, I'm exhausted. Work's been nonstop lately. I barely have time to cook, let alone see friends.
You give so much at your job, it's inspiring. But you should be taking care of yourself too! I wish I could be there and cook you a real meal. It gets lonely over here sometimes.
That means a lot. I wish you were here too. It sounds so tough being away for months. How do you cope?
Honestly? Talking to you helps more than you know. I feel like you really understand me, even with thousands of miles between us. I want to be someone you can count on, just like you've been for me.
You already are. It's rare to find someone I feel this close to. Most people just don't get what it's like, but with you it feels easy.

That means so much to me. I want to be honest with you about something, though. I just started a temporary assignment here with better pay, but my deployment check won't clear for 18 days. I'm in a bit of a bind for rent and groceries until then.
Oh no, that sounds rough. Aren't there any options with your unit?

Normally, yes, but because I just transferred, the paperwork's delayed. I feel a bit embarrassed even bringing this up, but I know I can trust you. Would you be able to help me out just this once? I'll pay you back the moment my pay arrives, I swear.
I don't know... I've never done anything like this before. How much do you need?
I'm so sorry to ask. If you could spare $200, it would cover my rent and enough food to last. I promise on my word as a soldier, it'll all come back to you by the end of the month.
That's a lot, but I want to help you if you really need it. How would I send you the money?

Thank you, seriously. It means everything. The best way is through Bitcoin because I can access it directly here. If you have a crypto wallet, I can send you my address. If not, I can walk you through it, it's actually pretty simple.
I don't have any crypto accounts, I've never tried that before. Is there another way?

I totally understand, it's new for a lot of people. The other way would be to buy prepaid Visa cards or Amazon gift cards at your local store. You'd just send me the codes, and I can use them for essentials here. Would you be comfortable doing that?
Yeah, I could do that. Just let me know how many and what kind.

If you're able to get two $100 Amazon gift cards or four $50 Visa cards, that would be perfect. Once you buy them, just snap a photo of the codes and send them here. I can't tell you how much I appreciate this. I feel so much closer to you because I can trust you with something important.
Okay, I'll go to the store after work. I hope things get easier for you soon.
Thank you, truly. I can't wait to make it up to you when I get back. You're such a kind soul, and I'm lucky to have you in my life.
You're welcome. I'll message you when I have the cards.
You're the best. Just send the codes and photos when you get home, and I'll take care of the rest. I'll be thinking of you all day.
Alright, I'll do that. Stay safe out there, okay?
Always. And thank you again, from the bottom of my heart. I hope you feel as cared for as you make me feel.
